ui.settingsSubtitle: Set your preferences for a guided experience
ui.yogaSubtitle: Union of breath, movement, and spirit
ui.corpsePoseSubtitle: Surrender your body completely to the earth
ui.piperReady: Piper voice ready for offline narration.
ui.piperLoadFailed: Piper could not load — using browser voice.
ui.piperPreviewFailed: Piper preview failed — choose a browser fallback voice.
ui.settingsHelpLanguages: Meditation Language controls the narration. Display Language controls the visible interface.
ui.settingsHelpChakras: Choose the chakras for the current journey in the Meditation Room. Reverse Journey changes their direction.
ui.chakraSelectionHelp: Choose the centres to include in this journey. You can adjust them here before beginning.
ui.settingsHelpYoga: Yoga Experience is selected in the Lobby. Its optional Corpse Pose and standard Bath Session are configured here. Intimate Service is selected separately in the Lobby.
ui.settingsHelpModes: Music Only, Sleep Mode, and High Energy are selected in the Lobby. Sleep Mode moves through five sound stages; Experience Modes are selected for the current journey only.
ui.settingsHelpAudioCredit: Pleasure ambience audio (audio/pleasure.mp3): supplied from Wikimedia Commons under CC0 1.0 Universal. Attribution is not legally required by CC0, but this credit is retained for provenance.
ui.settingsHelpSave: Save the settings to enter the Lobby. You can review the final mode and timing there before beginning.
ui.intimateServiceNote: Select the care stages needed for this guided service. Their order is always Perineal Care, Massage, then Assisted Bathing.
ui.massageReverseJourneyNote: Massage wraps a complete Crown-to-Root journey. All seven chakras are included and there is no separate massage timer.
ui.sleepModeIntro: A quiet, sleep-inspired sound journey is beginning. You may rest without following instructions.
ui.sleepStageGuidance: Let the sound remain in the background. Nothing needs to be forced.
ui.droneDurationSleepNote: Sleep Mode starts at Intermediate and changes its sleep-inspired sound gently at each stage.
ui.droneDurationHelp: The drone uses a fixed 20-second exposure window: Beginner 4s, Intermediate 10s, Advanced 14s, Expert 20s. Core practice duration does not change it.
ui.droneDurationHrimNote: For HRIM, Beginner is unavailable; Intermediate is the starting level.
ui.droneDurationActive: Active drone time: {duration} from each chakra start
ui.droneDurationActiveHrim: Active drone time: {duration} from HRIM start
ui.droneDurationActiveSleep: Active drone time: {duration} from each sleep stage start
ui.intentionPrompt: What are you calling in today?
ui.hrimDefaultIntention: Focused energy, courage, and clear action
ui.bathToYogaRestGuidance: The bath and care stage is complete. Rest quietly for fifteen minutes before Yoga. When the timer is complete, the guide will choose when to begin.
ui.restReadyToContinue: The rest is complete. Begin Yoga whenever you are ready.
ui.guideReadyForNextSessionGuidance: This stage is complete. Take the time you need; the session will continue only when the guide is ready.
ui.experimentSubtitle: Run one isolated guide activity. It does not change the journey plan or history.
ui.experimentNote: Only the selected activity runs. Care activities retain their guide-controlled completion step.
ui.yogaFlowNote: Yoga includes its selected poses and an optional standard Bath Session, followed by a guided rest before Yoga begins.
ui.mixerSubtitle: Tune the sound and comfort for this journey.
ui.mixerFrequencyNote: Changes apply from the next sound stage.
ui.restartConfirm: Restart this journey from the beginning? Your settings will be preserved.
ui.spatialNote: Narration stays centered; Spatial Sound adds a subtle ethereal presence while shaping music, drone and mantra.
ui.voicePaceNote: Pace changes apply from the next phrase.
ui.demoScriptTimingApplied: Demo journey ready — 30 seconds for each selected chakra.
ui.shotsHelp: One short frequency-only activation. No narration or background music. Sound Shots use Shot Duration; chakra Drone Duration modes do not apply.
ui.moodRelaxationShotNote: 221.23 Hz · A contemplative tone sometimes associated with sensual relaxation and connection; evidence for a frequency-specific effect is limited.
ui.shotConfirm: Are you sure you want to activate this frequency shot? It will play without narration or background music. Before continuing, disconnect any Bluetooth or external speaker. Lite cannot disconnect it for you. Use your device's built-in speaker at a safe, comfortable volume.
ui.shotInvalidFrequency: Enter a custom frequency greater than 0 Hz and no higher than 20,000 Hz.
ui.noFrequencyModeNote: Disables generated tones, drones, bells and Shots. Recorded mantra audio remains available.
ui.noMantraModeNote: Disables recorded mantra audio while keeping narration and background music available.
ui.moodRelaxationIntentionNote: When enabled, the supplied pleasure ambience loops throughout the guided session. Use the bounded level below to keep it subtle; No Frequency Mode overrides it. The level is saved, but the selection resets after reload.
ui.pleasureAmbienceIntensityNote: Changes clarity, texture and spatial presence without raising the bounded Ambience Level. This choice resets after reload.
ui.pleasureAmbienceUrlNote: Use a direct HTTP or HTTPS audio URL. It replaces only pleasure.mp3; numbered manifest layers remain unchanged. The host must allow browser audio access. Leave blank to use the standard manifest track.
ui.pleasureAmbienceUrlLoaded: Pleasure audio loaded. The numbered manifest layers remain active.
ui.pleasureAmbienceUrlError: Pleasure audio could not be loaded: {error}
ui.pleasureAmbienceSourceUnavailable: The local ambience audio is unavailable on this device. Add and load a direct audio URL to use Mood & Relaxation Ambience.
ui.moodRelaxationAmbienceLevelNote: This is a bounded source level from 0.2% to 7.0%, not a calibrated decibel reading. Above 5.0%, confirm before increasing. Actual loudness depends on the device and output volume.
ui.pleasureAmbienceAboveFiveConfirm: Pleasure ambience above 5.0% may be noticeably louder. Do you want to continue increasing it?
ui.pleasureAmbienceBlurNote: Adds a gentle diffused softness to the pleasure ambience while preserving the clean source underneath.
ui.pleasureAmbienceBlurLevelNote: Higher values soften more of the source while retaining a dry signal for clarity. The default is a moderate, spacious blur.
ui.noFrequencyShotsUnavailable: Shots are unavailable while No Frequency Mode is active. Turn it off in Settings to use a frequency-only Shot.
ui.safetySummary: Settle into a comfortable position and begin when you are ready to be guided. Keep your breathing natural; you may adjust your position at any time.
ui.consultationComingSoon: Session Consultation will open here in the next release. Your current meditation flow remains unchanged.

system.prePracticeSafety: Settle into a comfortable position. Your guide is here with you. Let your breathing remain natural, and allow yourself to arrive gently in this moment.
system.breatheAndSettle: Breathe and settle into the space
system.arrivalInduction: Feel the support beneath you. There is nothing to achieve or force. With each natural breath, you may become more settled and more relaxed, while remaining comfortably aware of the room and free to adjust at any time.
system.arrivalReadiness: Let your intention rest quietly within you. Keep only what feels supportive. With each breath, allow your attention to become a little steadier and a little deeper, in the way that feels right for you.
system.emergence: Take your time returning to the room. Notice the support beneath you, gently move your fingers and toes, and let your eyes open when you feel ready. Carry only what feels useful from this practice into the rest of your day.
system.intention: You are calling in: {{intention}}. Hold this in your heart — let it remain quietly with you through every moment of this journey.
system.centeringBreath: Sit comfortably. We will start with a centering breath.
system.breathingComplete: Breathing exercise is complete. Stay still for a moment.
system.corpsePoseSubtitle: Surrender your body completely to the earth
system.yogaSubtitle: Union of breath, movement, and spirit
system.breatheInterval: Take a break... breathe and prepare... for the next chakra
